grounding_gaps.reason: The moving body is an authored 0.5 mm sphere and the obstacle is an authored wall. They are not source-backed pipette, tip, labware, deck, or robot geometry, and no physical robot validation has been performed.
The native worker is process-resident and cannot be resumed from SQLite. Every reset creates a fresh worker generation.

sources.derivation: The runtime worker invokes the pinned device-free Opentrons 9.1.1 simulator and verifies the declared official source-file digest before accepting commands.
API Gym composes task, observation, dynamics, and incremental verifier logic over the runtime-owned native manager.
A self-authored 0.5 mm sphere and thin box wall provide an honest mathematical control fixture for whole-path checking.
